# powers, all computed with arkworks arithmetic.
#
#   kzg <degree> <seed> <z> <cm> <v> <w>
#
# Coefficients are <degree> + 1 draws from <seed>, then <z> is the
# next draw: a 32-byte little-endian draw with the top two bits
# cleared, rejecting values >= p. cm and w are G1 points in the
# 128-hex wire form; z and v are canonical Fr.
